principle: Every commander has one ownership-agnostic direct command budget with two simultaneous axes: direct personnel and direct command slots. Personal, assigned, attached, mercenary, institutional, or state troops consume the same budget when they report directly.
interpolation: Piecewise linear between anchors. Round personnel and slots down to whole numbers. Minimum one direct command slot.

direct_load.personnel: Sum personnel in leaf units that report directly to this commander, plus directly controlled named personnel not already inside those units. Ownership does not matter.
direct_load.leaf_unit_slots: One slot for each leaf unit reporting directly.
direct_load.subordinate_command_slots: One slot for each subordinate command node reporting directly, regardless of how many descendant units that subordinate controls.
direct_load.delegation: Whole units delegated to a subordinate cease counting against the superior direct-personnel and leaf-unit loads. The subordinate bears those loads. The superior instead bears one subordinate-command slot for that command node.
direct_load.strategic_authority: Recursive force size under authority is tracked separately and does not equal direct command load. A superior may command a force larger than personal direct capacity through lawful subordinate command nodes.

capacity_modifiers.formula: Use effective_capacity.factor_tables and combined_modifier exactly; no free-form percentage guessing.
capacity_modifiers.health_fatigue: Current health, fatigue, strain and cognitive condition of commander/staff.
capacity_modifiers.staff_and_signals: Qualified exact/materialized staff or occupied command-staff role slots, messengers/signals/communications, command posts, maps and relay quality. Role slots contribute only from current capability and availability evidence; vacancy or incapacity can reduce support.
capacity_modifiers.doctrine_familiarity: Commander/subordinates familiarity with the current organization and doctrine.
capacity_modifiers.terrain_dispersion: Distance, frontage, visibility, terrain and unit dispersion burden.
capacity_modifiers.information_quality: How current and reliable reports are; sensors/scouts/observers may improve it where the game permits.
capacity_modifiers.no_stat_buff: Command modifiers alter order latency, synchronization, reserve use, formation execution, morale/control and reaction quality. They never multiply soldiers permanent Strength, Endurance, weapon skill or other body capability.

bands.strained: either axis > 1.00x and <= 1.25x comfortable while neither exceeds 1.25x
bands.overloaded: either axis > 1.25x and <= 1.50x comfortable while neither exceeds 1.50x

effects.comfortable: normal deterministic command execution from saved doctrine, communications and commander skill
effects.strained: moderate order delay, reduced simultaneous maneuver quality and slower reserve response
effects.overloaded: large order delay, synchronization loss, more units fall back to standing doctrine/current orders, complex maneuvers become unreliable
effects.breakdown: commander cannot reliably issue new synchronized control to the excess direct span; excess branches act from last valid orders/standing doctrine until delegation, reorganization or load reduction restores control

anti_fragmentation.rule: Splitting creates organizational flexibility only. It never creates people, equipment, frontage, action economy, morale, experience or combat power.
anti_fragmentation.cost: Each additional directly controlled child unit consumes a direct command slot. Delegation can reduce superior direct load but requires a real qualified subordinate and valid communication chain.
anti_fragmentation.tiny_unit_rule: Tiny units do not gain free independent actions merely by existing; physical frontage, timing, communication and actual personnel still constrain what they can accomplish.

ownership_agnostic: Personal and assigned troops never receive separate command-capacity ledgers. If they report directly to the same commander, they share the same personnel and command-slot limits.

worked_example.commander_comfort: 10000 direct personnel and 8 direct command slots
worked_example.before: 15000 direct personnel and 10 direct command slots: above comfort
worked_example.delegation: delegate 5000 personnel in 4 whole units to one qualified subordinate
worked_example.superior_after: 10000 direct personnel; 6 direct leaf units + 1 subordinate command node = 7 direct command slots; strategic authority still covers all 15000
worked_example.subordinate_after: 5000 direct personnel and 4 direct leaf units
worked_example.validity: Both commanders must independently satisfy their effective capacities and the communication/authority chain must be valid.

setting_modifiers.communications: staff, runners, flags, drums, horns, signal towers, maps, roads and prepared command posts where actually available
setting_modifiers.army_note: Large armies are expected to require nested command. A commander may hold strategic authority over very large forces while directly controlling only a manageable set of units and subordinate command nodes.

effective_capacity.base: Piecewise-linear interpolation of the rating anchors, rounded down.
effective_capacity.selection_rule: Choose each factor only from current saved evidence. For staff_and_signals, use exact/materialized staff and/or occupied command-staff role capability/availability together with actual communications resources and conditions; do not count slots as an automatic bonus. If evidence does not support a better category, use normal/adequate/familiar. Do not grant a bonus because a commander is important or named.

load_evaluation.band: comfortable if <=1.00; strained if >1.00 and <=1.25; overloaded if >1.25 and <=1.50; breakdown if >1.50
load_evaluation.application: These multipliers modify command/control execution only: order delay, synchronized maneuver reliability, reserve response and how much of the direct span can accept a new complex order at once. They never multiply soldier body/weapon capability.
load_evaluation.breakdown: At load_ratio>1.50, new synchronized control is limited to a lawful subset within effective span. Excess direct branches continue the last valid order/standing doctrine until delegation, reorganization, rally/recovery or communication improvement restores control.

hierarchy.recursive_rule: Every command node is evaluated independently with the same two-axis rules.
hierarchy.superior_load: A subordinate command node consumes exactly one direct command slot in its parent and none of the subordinate descendant personnel count as parent direct personnel.
hierarchy.subordinate_load: The subordinate commander bears all directly reporting units/personnel and subordinate nodes under that node.
hierarchy.strategic_total: Track recursive personnel and unit totals for reporting/logistics/authority, but never substitute them for direct-load capacity.
hierarchy.ownership: Ownership is irrelevant to command load. Personal, assigned, attached, allied-under-command and hired units all count identically when directly reporting.
hierarchy.depth: Each hierarchy edge may add real communication latency from the setting communication mechanics. Delegation reduces span load but never makes information travel instantly.

command_group_state.manpower_rule: A command group owns no people and cannot be attacked as a substitute troop unit. It references real troop units, named direct people, subordinate command groups, and one commander person.
command_group_state.parent_slot_rule: One direct subordinate command group consumes exactly one parent direct command slot, regardless of descendant unit count.
command_group_state.presentation_rule: SHOW COMMAND lists direct troop units and direct subordinate command groups as peer command elements. A subordinate command group may be displayed as <Commander Name> Command, with its child units nested underneath.
command_group_state.creation_rule: Create/update a command group only from a real appointment, delegation, operational assignment, or explicit lawful player order. OOC/previews never create one.

commander_personal_combat.person_rule: A commander/officer is always a person, never a one-person troop unit. If physically present in an engagement, resolve personal movement, equipment, combat, wounds, fatigue, capture, death and retreat from that person owner.
commander_personal_combat.headcount_rule: The commander does not add +1 to a troop unit headcount unless the character is explicitly a member of that unit under the unit membership model.
commander_personal_combat.stat_rule: Personal body/weapon/stamina/combat stats resolve only the commander personal actions. Command skills affect subordinate command/control through this mechanic and never get averaged into soldier body stats.
commander_personal_combat.succession_rule: If a commander is incapacitated, killed, captured, cut off, or unable to communicate, resolve deputy/successor/standing-doctrine behavior. If the superior directly absorbs orphaned child units, those units immediately count against the superior direct personnel and slot loads.

display_example.slot_count: Wei uses 4 direct command slots in this display: 3 direct troop units + 1 subordinate command group. Jang separately bears the personnel and slot load of the units nested under Jang Command.
